audited_result: Target A (terminal_gross_pnl_atr > 0), 2023 fit -> frozen -> 2024 scored once

capacity.early_stopping: none (no validation set passed to fit)
capacity.subsample_note: LightGBM bags only when subsample_freq > 0; it is unset, so the declared row subsampling never applied

findings_not_invalidating_the_result.detail: 22 of 78 features are absolute price levels; 94.8-96.0% of 2024 rows fall outside the entire 2023 range of each. NQ traded roughly 10,750-17,165 in 2023 and 16,334-22,152 in 2024. Within 2023 these columns are near-unique memorisation handles; in 2024 they are pure extrapolation (2024/2023 score sd ratio 0.616, frozen deciles D1/D10 nearly empty).
findings_not_invalidating_the_result.severity: design defect in the declared feature surface
findings_not_invalidating_the_result.why_not_the_explanation: the within-2023 holdout has only ~25% of rows outside the train range on these columns and still collapses to 0.5169

findings_not_invalidating_the_result.detail: subsample 0.8 never applied because subsample_freq is unset; one of two declared regularisers did nothing
constant across all 2023 training rows: checkpoint_seconds_since_flip, bars_1m
prior_frozen_atr_1h, prior_mfe_atr_1h, prior_mae_atr_1h and prior_terminal_displacement_atr_1h move from 0.0% to 1.206% null in 2024

interpretation: The pipeline is correct: population, target, feature order and semantics, the fit-time matrix (golden-frame parity at max_abs_diff 0.0), persisted predictions and both reported AUCs all reproduce exactly under independent reimplementation. The collapse is a real result and the study NO_INFORMATION verdict stands. Its cause is memorisation, not domain shift: the estimator reaches 0.9711 training AUC on RANDOMLY SHUFFLED labels, so the 0.9783 in-sample figure measures capacity and nothing else; and the model already fails inside 2023, scoring 0.5169 on a predeclared chronological holdout against 0.5137 on 2024, at a quarter of the price extrapolation. CASE 3 (temporal shift) is contradicted. The null is corroborated by the two low-capacity, price-free controls, which also show no holdout skill (0.5091, 0.4985), so no signal is being masked. CAVEAT: this experiment did not cleanly TEST the research question, because it ran at a capacity that fits noise to 0.97 over a surface containing 22 non-stationary absolute price columns. A re-specified run (price levels removed or ATR-normalised, capacity matched to the sample, subsample_freq set so the declared bagging applies, within-2023 holdout carried) remains untested and was NOT performed here.
stop_condition_rationale: No parity failure was found. The defects recorded above are specification/capacity defects that EXPLAIN the measured numbers rather than invalidate them, so no repaired pipeline is being silently reused over the already-opened 2024 result.

temporal_holdout_split.rule: first 70% of 2023 session days train / final 30% holdout, by complete session
